voice: Preserve Carter's vanity, elitism, and hostility while removing collateral ethnic caricature and factual anachronisms.

entries.text: That is where I arrived after crossing from England. I accompanied the Egyptian exhibit, and apparently Dr. Carrington was aboard the same steamship, though I never encountered him during the voyage.
Lo Fat runs one of the local laundries. A remarkably well-read fellow, though he enjoys letting customers underestimate him.
Of course I know Rameses. There were several. Rameses I founded the Nineteenth Dynasty, though his brief reign was overshadowed by Rameses II.
During his long reign, Rameses II commissioned immense building projects whose marks remain across Egypt.
Stay clear of Smith. He has called me a thief in public and threatened me in private. The man is a dangerous zealot.
Miss Delacroix is shamelessly flirtatious. Naturally she has made advances toward me; naturally I have resisted them.
